name: constella
description: One memory for all your coding agents. Decisions, rules and handoffs saved in Constella come back in every session, in every AI tool, for the repo you are in.

api_key.title: Constella API key
api_key.description: Optional. A key from the Constella desktop app (Settings > Developer). With it, memory for this repo loads at session start and before edits. Without it, the tools still work after a browser sign-in.

save_to.title: Save memories to
save_to.description: Where new memories go. "me" is your own memory.
